supporting_observations.claim: At 13:56:13 UTC, a Windows 4648 event on WS-MFISCHER-01 records SYSTEM running PowerShell with explicit credentials targeting svc-ledger on FILE-SUN-01.

The recorded credential use is unusual relative to the provided context: svc-ledger is described as a LedgerSync service account running on FILE-SUN-01, while the documented workstation patching workflow uses WS-IDOYLE-01. This warrants investigation, but does not establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence contains only one record for this review; it does not substantiate the alert's description of repeated failures around 13:40 UTC.
Event 4648 records use of explicit credentials but, by itself, does not establish whether authentication succeeded or failed.
The record does not identify the person or process that initiated the PowerShell activity beyond reporting SYSTEM and the process name.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-ledger authentication attempt failed, succeeded, or was followed by a logon session.
Whether the event is part of the reported repeated failures around 13:40 UTC.
Whether the activity was authorized troubleshooting or a password-rotation/job-update action, or was initiated maliciously.
Whether the PowerShell process performed any subsequent actions on FILE-SUN-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain controller and FILE-SUN-01 authentication events for svc-ledger in the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window, including success and failure events.
Process creation, parent-process, command-line, and relevant PowerShell logs from WS-MFISCHER-01 around 13:56 UTC.
Evidence of any resulting logon session or activity on FILE-SUN-01, and records of the scheduled password rotation and LedgerSync job update.
